::: {#rem-p-vs-np}
#### The P versus NP question

Whether $\mathrm{P} = \mathrm{NP}$ is open:
no one has shown that some problem in NP lies outside P,
or found polynomial-time algorithms for every problem in NP
[@arora2009computational, section 2.7].
Most researchers expect the classes to differ,
which would mean that, for some problems,
checking a proposed answer is much easier than finding one.

:::
